name: human-review
title_zh: 发出去之前先让本人拿笔在你稿子上划一遍
tagline_zh: 你替他写的东西，最怕他看完只说「还行」。这个技能把草稿摊在他面前：他直接改字、圈选任何一句留批注。
tagline_en: Stop guessing what they meant by "looks fine." They retype lines, comment on any selection, and scribble on.
desc_en: Put a draft in front of the person you are working for and get their markup back in one batch: they retype text, comment on any selection, and circle or scribble on images and PDF pages with a note per mark. Use before anything they will read, print or publish: post, spec, plan, report, newsletter, landing page, deck, invitation, poster, chart, rendered design, screenshot.
why_zh: 批注不落在聊天记录里，而是钉在原文和画面上，位置本身就是信息。一轮收齐，省掉三轮「您说的是哪句」。
why_en: Markup lives on the artifact, not in chat — position carries meaning. One round instead of three rounds of "which line did you.
limit_zh: 只负责把草稿递过去、把标记收回来，不替你改稿也不判断对错；对方得愿意动手划，只回一句「可以」就等于没跑；纯音频。
limit_en: Only delivers the draft and collects markup — it won't edit or judge. If they just say "fine," nothing happens. No audio, no code diffs, no.
title_en: Get the boss's own red pen on your draft first
